user.title: Safety Monitor Setup
user.description: Initialize the 24/7 Safety & Hazard Monitoring System (Smoke, Moisture, Gas, Carbon Monoxide, Heat). Found {sensors_found} hazard-capable sensor(s) in Home Assistant.

silence.name: Silence Alarm
silence.description: Temporarily silences acoustic sirens and flashes without disarming the 24/7 monitoring.

reset.name: Reset / Acknowledge Alarm
reset.description: Acknowledges safety alerts and returns system state back to normal.

trigger.name: Trigger Emergency Alarm
trigger.description: Manually triggers the full hazard alarm sequence.
